subject: Re: [AMBER] About utilities to convert Amber input files for MD into the Tinker, NAMD, Genesis, or Desmond input files

messages.author: Pengfei Li
messages.body:
Hi Vlad,
Here are two tutorials about using AMBER force field in CHARMM: https://ambermd.org/tutorials/pengfei/gaff4charmm.htm <https://ambermd.org/tutorials/pengfei/gaff4charmm.htm>, https://ambermd.org/tutorials/advanced/tutorial20/charmm.htm <https://ambermd.org/tutorials/advanced/tutorial20/charmm.htm>, which are not the exact things you want (as you want to convert to Tinker, NAMD, Genesis, or Desmond input files) but hope it helps anyway.
Pengfei
